name: galbook
description: Play a galgame / visual novel like a human would: read one line at a time, pick choices yourself and write down why, save, load, rewind to the last choice. It also sees the screen — the background, who stands on which side, which expression; the first time it meets a CG the image comes with the text, and galbook_look shows whatever is on screen right now. Ships an MCP server, an HTTP server and a CLI, plus a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle.
author: CHET-LI
